method: Exact clipping of original painted inner-disc surfaces and hub, retaining the largest area connected source component. Disconnected original case/support fragments return to the static body. Measured existing rim boundary receives only an inset internal back and side closure; the new internal back ring alone uses boundary-arclength parameterization to avoid tiny projected rim foldbacks, and original ring vertices remain unchanged; small cut boundaries interpolate UV from original nearby painted/wooden source faces. This is original neural front geometry with local mechanical cut repairs, not a replacement disc or image repaint.
limitations: Original outer wooden rim and rear case stay fixed while the painted inner face and original hub rotate.
New internal closure is a documented mechanical repair, not unseen native-generated rear geometry.
Requires actual asymmetric pose review before approval.

visualReview.notes: All nine actual 0/45/90 front/right/isometric images and four neutral-material front/right images at 0/90 were inspected individually. Existing painted inner plate and hub rotate, while original outer bronze rim, pointer, rear pedestal and whole building stay fixed. The earlier foreground copper strip no longer moves. A narrow native pointer-occlusion mark and slightly uneven local relief remain on the painted plate; neutral material shows continuous geometry, not a through-hole. At mobile scale this is a minor inherited surface imperfection. New internal side/back closure and tiny nonplanar hub-boundary fan are explicit local mechanical repair, not a new complete disc.

verificationNote: Every original source triangle is exactly partitioned without moving its original vertices. Position-welded moving surface has zero open/nonmanifold edges at1e-6. Embedded images and original material JSON are byte/value unchanged.
